resume.summary: Results-driven Software Developer with 7+ years of experience architecting and delivering scalable systems across fintech, healthcare, and education. Proficient in full-stack development using Laravel, Node.js, React, Vue, Flutter, and ASP.NET, with strong expertise in microservices, Docker, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and RESTful APIs. Proven leader — successfully led development teams, launched virtual payment solutions, created a custom Linux distro, and mentored developers. Passionate about leveraging data-driven engineering and open-source innovation to solve real-world challenges.

bullets: Currently leading the development team: coordinating tasks and mentoring junior developers.
Built a healthcare platform to connect patients with providers and an employment portal for job seekers and recruiters.
Developed educational and retail management systems that streamline content delivery and sales workflows.
Project manager for ZainCar (Jordan) — full-time remote from Cairo, Oct 2023 – Dec 2025, owning delivery across the ZainCar client and driver apps (zaincar.com).
In the same period launched the OpenWasit marketplace app (openwasit.com) and the OnRide driver app (onridedrive.com).
Architected multi-tenant solutions for appraisal services, ensuring high availability and security.
Optimized system performance by refactoring the codebase and introducing microservices patterns.
Automated deployment pipelines with Docker and GitLab CI, reducing release time by 40%.
Led a cross-functional team to deliver a local & international payment gateway platform.
Integrated third-party APIs (Stripe, PayPal) and launched virtual Visa/Mastercard issuance.
Managed project roadmap, sprint planning, and performance reviews to meet all deadlines.
Built high-performance backend systems for banking and government statistics portals.
Designed & implemented ERP modules, improving operational efficiency by 30%.
Developed APIs for the government web portal CBS.gov.sd, handling 1M+ monthly transactions.
Developed RESTful APIs for the Sudanese Islamic Bank mobile application, enabling secure banking operations.

honors: Ranked 2nd in the university's best graduation projects (2018).
Awarded a training scholarship by the National Software Center (NSC Sudan).
